author: musho7-dev
subject: Garage: every car card shows a photo of the car with tires
body:
thumbs.gd draws all cars (body, tires, driver, and the player's paint,
decal and tire choice) into one off-screen picture, cuts it into one
texture per car and caches it; only cars whose look changed are redrawn.
Code-drawn cars (Buggy, Monster Truck, Rocket Bike, funny vehicles,
My Car) now have pictures, and picture cars now show their wheels.
